trust.title: Trust & Security
trust.subtitle: We take security and privacy seriously. Here's exactly how AutoCAD Coach protects your data.
trust.legalIntro: For full details, read our legal documents:

pillars.authBody: All accounts are secured via managed authentication with email/password. Passwords are never stored in plain text — they are hashed with bcrypt. Session tokens are short-lived and stored in secure HTTP-only cookies.
pillars.storageBody: Your account data is stored in an encrypted-at-rest database. Learning progress (XP, completed lessons, streak) is stored in your browser's local storage and is never transmitted without your consent.
pillars.assetsBody: Lesson images and screenshots use Row Level Security policies. Only verified admin accounts can upload, modify, or delete course content. All other users have read-only access.
pillars.trackingBody: We do not use advertising trackers, third-party analytics, or data brokers. We do not sell your personal data. The only third-party services we rely on are our managed backend and our AI gateway.
pillars.aiBody: Messages sent to AutoCoach are processed in real time and are not stored on our servers. Your conversation history exists only in your browser session and is cleared when you leave the page.
pillars.contactBody: If you discover a security vulnerability or have concerns about your data, please contact us at schavezsaife@gmail.com. We take all reports seriously and aim to respond within 48 hours.

legal.privacyIntro: AutoCAD Coach is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.
legal.privacyCollect1: Account data: name, email, and profile photo when you register.
legal.privacyCollect2: Usage data: lessons completed, XP earned, quiz results stored locally in your browser.
legal.privacyCollect3: Technical data: browser type, device type, IP address collected via standard web logs.
legal.privacyCollect4: AI conversations: messages to AutoCoach are processed in real time and not permanently stored.
legal.privacyUse1: To provide and maintain the AutoCAD Coach platform.
legal.privacyUse2: To personalize your learning experience and track progress.
legal.privacyUse3: To communicate with you about your account.
legal.privacyUse4: To improve content, features, and AI tutor responses.
legal.privacyStorageBody: Your progress is stored in your browser and not transmitted to our servers unless signed in. Account data is stored securely with encryption at rest.
legal.privacyThird2: AI Gateway — powers AutoCoach (messages not stored).
legal.privacyRights: You may access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at
legal.termsIntro: By using AutoCAD Coach you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
legal.termsServiceBody: AutoCAD Coach provides AutoCAD lessons, projects, quizzes, and an AI tutor for educational purposes only.
legal.termsAccount2: You are responsible for your account credentials and all activity under your account.
legal.termsAccount3: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account.
legal.termsUse1: Do not use the service for unlawful purposes.
legal.termsUse2: Do not attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the service.
legal.termsUse3: Do not scrape or redistribute lesson content without permission.
legal.termsIpBody: All content including lessons, projects, and the AutoCoach AI system is owned by AutoCAD Coach and protected by copyright.
legal.termsAiBody: AutoCoach responses may not always be accurate. Verify critical information against official Autodesk documentation. We are not liable for AI errors.
legal.termsLiabilityBody: AutoCAD Coach is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service.
legal.cookiesIntro: Cookies are small text files placed on your device. We use a minimal set.
legal.cookiesUse1: Authentication cookies: set when you sign in. Strictly necessary to keep you logged in.
legal.cookiesUse2: Preference storage: sidebar open/closed state in your browser — never transmitted to our servers.
legal.cookiesControlBody: You can control cookies in your browser settings. Disabling auth cookies will prevent you from staying signed in.
legal.cookiesLocalBody: Learning progress is stored in your browser only. Clear it anytime via your browser's site data settings.
legal.trustAuthBody: Accounts secured via managed auth. Passwords hashed with bcrypt. Session tokens stored in secure HTTP-only cookies.
legal.trustStorageBody: Account data in an encrypted database. Learning progress stays in your browser's local storage.
legal.trustAssetsBody: Lesson images use Row Level Security. Only verified admin accounts can modify course content.
legal.trustTrackingBody: No advertising trackers, no analytics, no data brokers. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.trustAiBody: AutoCoach messages are processed in real time and not stored on our servers.
legal.trustReportsBody: Found a vulnerability? Email schavezsaife@gmail.com — we respond within 48 hours.
